title.zh: 比较两条路线的耗电量
title.en: Compare the Energy Cost of Two Routes

brief.zh: 查表读取经过的地板耗电量，观察两个累计值怎样变化。
brief.en: Look up the energy cost of each entered tile and follow the two running totals.

concept.zh: 累计进入每个格子的代价，从起点之后开始
concept.en: Add each entry cost, starting after the starting tile

title.en: Two steps direct, four for the detour

examples.source:
plan = scan()
costs = plan["costs"]
for route in plan["routes"]:
    total = 0
    for step in range(1, len(route)):
        cell = route[step]
        total += costs[cell[1]][cell[0]]
        say(str(total))
    submit(total)
